faq.empty: No answer for that yet. Ask everyone in the group.

install.q: Do I need to install an app?
install.a: No. Open the site in your phone's browser and play. If you play often, tap Install app to add it to your home screen and open it full screen.

free.a: No. Every role, every style and every feature is free. If you want to help keep the servers running, you can donate on the site. Donations unlock nothing extra.

players.q: How many players do I need?
players.a: At least {min} and at most {max} per room. Bots fill missing seats. A game needs {stats} or more real people to count as Standard and reach the leaderboard.

signIn.q: Do I have to sign in?
signIn.a: Not to play. The room creator needs a Google account. Sign in to keep your game history, win rate, card collection and quests.

narrator.a: If everyone plays online from different places, pick Machine host. It runs the game and you play too. If the group sits together and wants a narrator, pick I'll host and open the projector screen on a TV.

seeRole.q: Where do I see my role?
seeRole.a: Press and hold the card on your phone to see it, let go to hide it. Not sure what to do? Tap 💡 Tips for this role. Keep your screen to yourself.

noPower.q: My role has nothing to do tonight. Now what?
noPower.a: Just wait. When a role is called, only its holder sees the buttons. In the day, talk naturally and don't give away that you did nothing last night.

vote.a: During the day the village picks suspects to put on the stand. They get to defend themselves, then the village decides to hang or spare them. A tie means a revote between the tied players. The {mayor} counts twice.

dead.a: You keep watching the game and talk in the Chat for the dead. The living can't read it, the village sees it when the game ends. Don't tip off the living!

leave.q: What if I leave or lose connection mid-game?
leave.a: Open the room link again and pick your name to take back your seat with the same role. Away for more than 1 minute, a bot plays for you until you tap the screen. Away for more than 5 minutes, you are out and a bot plays your seat to the end.

win.a: The village wins when every wolf is gone. The wolves win when they are as many as everyone else left alive. Solo roles have their own win, and while a solo killer is alive no team has won yet.

firstRole.q: Which role is best for a beginner?
firstRole.a: {villager} is the easiest, you just listen, ask and vote. {bodyguard} and {hunter} are easy too. {seer} and {witch} matter a lot, so keep them secret. Being the {werewolf} the first time is scary, just talk like a villager.

seer.a: The Seer learns whether a player is a wolf, not their role. Careful, a few roles fool the Seer, namely {roles}.

roleSet.q: How do I pick a balanced set of roles?
roleSet.a: In the room settings tap Use suggestion and the machine deals a balanced set for your player count. To tune it yourself, the number of roles must match the number of players. The standard sets are in How to play on the home page.

solo.a: A solo role is neither village nor wolf. Each wins its own way, for example the {tanner} wants to be hanged and the {arsonist} must be the last one standing.

collection.q: How do I unlock cards in the collection?
collection.a: Win a game with a role to unlock its card. {bronze} win for bronze, {silver} for silver, {gold} for gold and {rainbow} for rainbow. Every win counts.

quests.q: What are quests and gold for?
quests.a: Open 📜 Quests to check in and do small quests every day. Finishing them earns gold. Gold is a score to show off, it doesn't buy anything.

friends.a: Tap a player to open their profile and tap Add friend. Requests show up in Chat under Friends. Friends in a room show up so you can join or watch.

voice.a: Tap Turn on mic to talk or Listen in to just listen, and let the browser use your microphone. Can't hear anything? Tap Tap to hear. Mobile data sometimes blocks voice, chat still works fine.

inApp.q: The link breaks inside Zalo, Messenger or Facebook?
inApp.a: Browsers inside those apps often block the mic and drop the connection. Tap ⋯ or ⋮ in the corner and pick Open in browser, or copy the link into Chrome or Safari.

language.q: How do I change the language?
language.a: Tap the language button in the top left corner. Each player picks their own language, so Vietnamese and English speakers can share a room.

screen.q: Is there a shared screen for a TV?
screen.a: Yes. In a room you host, tap Open projector screen and open that page on a TV, laptop or projector for everyone to see.

phone.title: Your phone is your card
phone.tip1: Press and hold the card to see your role, let go to hide it. Keep your screen to yourself.
phone.tip2: Tap 💡 Tips for this role when you are not sure what to do.
phone.tip3: When your role is called at night, your phone shows the buttons to pick someone.
phone.tip4: In the day, talk in chat or turn on your mic, then vote right on your phone.

manners.title: Play nice so everyone has fun
manners.tip1: Don't reveal your role outside the game or share screenshots.
manners.tip2: Once dead, talk in the Chat for the dead and don't tip off the living.
manners.tip3: Don't leave mid-game. After 1 minute away a bot plays for you, after 5 minutes you are out.
manners.tip4: Suspect away, but keep the arguing fun and friendly.
